kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-product --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang en --role-for 1733269771123 --product-id alibaba_cloud_sas --product-name alibaba_cloud_sas --vendor-name 111 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProduct

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) is located. Select the management center region based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response messages. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English. This parameter is required. If not provided, the service returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。此参数实际为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to another member's view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The product ID. Only products with ProductType set to custom support updates. System preset products (ProductType set to preset) cannot be modified. Calling this operation on a preset product returns a 403 error. To create a custom product, use the CreateProduct API first. This parameter is the resource identifier for the Update operation and is required. Only custom products can be updated. System preset products cannot be updated
parameters.help_zh:
产品ID。仅 ProductType 为 custom 的产品支持更新；系统预置产品（ProductType 为 preset）不可修改，调用将返回 403 错误。如需自定义产品，请先通过 CreateProduct API 创建。
此参数为 Update 操作的资源标识符，实际为必填项。仅支持更新自定义产品，系统预置产品不可更新
parameters.name: product_id
